item.title: 👊 Every enemy's stronghold requires it's own 'corkscrew' Assault detachments of the 5th Separate Guards Tank Brigade uncovered and wiped out a large stronghold of the AFU in Zaporo
item.description: 👊 Every enemy's stronghold requires it's own 'corkscrew' 📍 Assault detachments of the 5th Separate Guards Tank Brigade uncovered and wiped out a large stronghold of the AFU in Zaporozhye region. Most of the stronghold's fortifications were mopped up during the first attempt, but one of the objects turned out to be set deeply under groung and tightly camouflaged. Outside it seemed a small shelter, but during the assault, it became clear that the main part was under ground. 💬 The commander of the assault company with the call sign 'Max' gave details about 'corkscrews' used by Russian servicemen to wipe out the Ukrainan Nazi lair. 🔹 Russian Defence Ministry

👊
Every enemy's stronghold requires it's own 'corkscrew'
📍
Assault detachments of the 5th Separate Guards Tank Brigade uncovered and wiped out a large stronghold of the AFU in Zaporozhye region.
Most of the stronghold's fortifications were mopped up during the first attempt,
but one of the objects turned out to be set deeply under groung and tightly camouflaged. Outside it seemed a small shelter,
but during the assault, it became clear that the main part was under ground.
💬
The commander of the assault company with the call sign 'Max' gave details about 'corkscrews' used by Russian servicemen to wipe out the Ukrainan Nazi lair.
🔹
Russian Defence Ministry

🚩
The Vostok Group's units advanced to the depths of the enemy's defence and liberated Chervonaya Krinitsa (Zaporozhye region).
💥
Strikes were launched at
manpower and hardware of one mechanised brigade, two assault brigades, two air assault brigades, four assault regiments of the Armed Forces of Ukraine, and one marine brigade close to Barvinovka, Vasinovka, Nikolskoye, Obshcheye, Vasilyevskoye (Zaporozhye region), and Shevyakino (Dnepropetrovsk region).
▫️
The enemy has lost more than 295 troops, three motor vehicles, and one U.S.-made AN/TPQ-50 counter-fire station.
🚩
As a result of the decisive actions of the Dnepr Group of Forces units, Novopavlovka (Zaporozhye region) was liberated.
💥

manpower and hardware of one mechanised brigade, one mountain assault brigade, one artillery brigade, and one assault regiment of the Armed Forces of Ukraine close to Orekhov, Chervony Zhovten, and Preobrazhenka (Zaporozhye region).
▫️
Up to 65 troops, 16 motor vehicles, one artillery gun, and three electronic warfare stations were neutralised.

▫️
Air defence systems shot down
13 guided aerial bombs, one U.S.-made HIMARS MLRS projectile, and 1,050 fixed-wing unmanned aerial vehicles.

item.content:encoded:

The Armed Forces of the Russian Federation continue the special military operation.
📍
The units of the Sever Group of Forces improved the tactical situation.
They hit manpower and hardware of one mechanised brigade, one airmobile brigade of the Armed Forces of Ukraine, and two territorial defence brigades near Ulanovo, Korenek, Malaya Rybitsa, and Streletskaya Pushkarka (Sumy region).
💥
In Kharkov region, strikes were delivered at
formations of two mechanised brigades, one motorised infantry brigade, one assault regiment of the Armed Forces of Ukraine, and one border detachment of the State Border Guard Service of Ukraine near the settlements of Sosnovy Bor, Berezhnoye, Podsredneye, Rublenoye, and Prikolotnoye (Kharkov region).
▫️
The AFU losses amounted to up to 210 troops, one armoured fighting vehicle, 11 motor vehicles, one artillery gun, and one electronic warfare station.
📍
The Zapad Group of Forces units took more advantageous lines and positions.
Strikes were delivered at manpower and hardware of two mechanised brigades, one airmobile brigade of the Armed Forces of Ukraine, one marine brigade, and one territorial defence brigade close to Lesnaya Stenka, Grushevka (Kharkov region), Svyatogorsk, Sidorovo, and Shchurovo (Donetsk People's Republic).
▫️
The enemy losses amounted to more than 180 troops, two armoured fighting vehicles, 19 motor vehicles, three field artillery guns, including one Polish-made Krab self-propelled artillery system, and one U.S.-made AN/TPQ-50 counter-fire station.
📍
The Yuzhnaya Group of Forces improved the tactical situation along the front line.
The Russian troops hit formations of two mechanised brigades, one airmobile brigade, one mountain assault brigade, two unmanned systems brigades of the Armed Forces of Ukraine, and territorial defence brigade near Slavyansk, Kramatorsk, Vasyutinskoye, Druzhkovka, Kurtovka, and Raiskoye (Donetsk People's Republic).
▫️
The enemy has lost more than 210 troops, three Western-made armoured fighting vehicles, 25 motor vehicles, and two field artillery guns.
📍
The Tsentr Group's units improved the tactical situation.
Strikes were inflicted on manpower and hardware of three mechanised brigades, one jaeger brigade, one assault brigade of the Armed Forces of Ukraine, one marine brigade, and three national guard brigades near Andreyevka, Belozerskoye, Raksha, Novofedorovka, and Novotroitskoye (Donetsk People's Republic).
▫️
More than 365 troops, two armoured fighting vehicles, 18 motor vehicles, and three field artillery guns were neutralised.
👉
See
Part 2
🔹
Russian Defence Ministry

item.title: 🍁 Good luck! Leonid Gornin congratulated the Military University on Knowledge Day.
item.description: 🍁 Good luck! Leonid Gornin congratulated the Military University on Knowledge Day. 💬 The first Deputy Defence Minister of the Russian Federation congratulated cadets and teachers of the Military University of the Russian Defence Ministry on the start of the new academic year. He wished everyone success and noted that an important project, 'Military education in the service of the Fatherland,' is actively developing on the initiative of the Minister of Defence. 📌 There's a lot of interesting and important work ahead, because the main goal is to make studying even more modern and high-quality. Here is what Leonid Gornin said about the project: The key courses of the project are: military education adaptation to new requirements of combat operations involving the use of modern military hardware, material and technical facilities development, creating conditions for continuous vocational education. 📚 May this academic year bring new and useful knowledge, loyal friends, and pride for your work! Good luck on your way to new heights! 🔹 Russian Defence Ministry

item.title: ❗️ Last night, the Armed Forces of the Russian Federation carried out a massive strike with high-precision weapons and long-range attack unmanned aerial vehicles against enterprise
item.description: ❗️ Last night, the Armed Forces of the Russian Federation carried out a massive strike with high-precision weapons and long-range attack unmanned aerial vehicles against enterprises of military-industrial and fuel-power systems in Kiev and Kiev region, as well as infrastructure facilities in Odessa, Odessa region, the ports of Odessa and Chernomorsk used to store and deliver military supplies, fuel and lubricants for the Armed Forces of Ukraine. 📍 The following targets were hit in Kiev: ▫️ an industry enterprise of Fire Point LLC. It produced components and combat units for FP-5 Flamingo long-range cruise missiles, as well as solid-fuel accelerators; ▫️ an industry enterprise of Aerobavovna LLC. It produced aerostats to deliver and provide control of long- and medium-range unmanned aerial vehicles, including the Hornet loitering munitions; ▫️ a locomotive shed of Darnitsa. It repaired railway locomotives, and it was one of the key service centres of the locomotive fleet involved in delivering military cargo. 📍 The following targets were hit in Kiev region: ▫️ a uncrewed surface vehicle manufacturing and storing workshop in the settlement of Khotov; ▫️ an oil refinery delivering POLs to the AFU in the settlement of Borispol. 📍 The following targets were hit in Odessa and Odessa region: ▫️ an electric power plant and three electric substations, which operated the port infrastructure, as well as a UAV assembly workshop; 💥 16 depots with military weaponry and hardware and six POL
item.content:encoded:

❗️
Last night, the Armed Forces of the Russian Federation
carried out a massive strike with high-precision weapons and long-range attack unmanned aerial vehicles against enterprises of military-industrial and fuel-power systems in Kiev and Kiev region,
as well as infrastructure facilities in Odessa, Odessa region, the ports of Odessa and Chernomorsk used to store and deliver military supplies, fuel and lubricants for the Armed Forces of Ukraine.
📍
The following targets were hit in Kiev:
▫️
an industry enterprise of Fire Point LLC.
It produced components and combat units for FP-5 Flamingo long-range cruise missiles, as well as solid-fuel accelerators;
▫️
an industry enterprise of Aerobavovna LLC.
It produced aerostats to deliver and provide control of long- and medium-range unmanned aerial vehicles, including the Hornet loitering munitions;
▫️
a locomotive shed of Darnitsa.
It repaired railway locomotives, and it was one of the key service centres of the locomotive fleet involved in delivering military cargo.
📍
The following targets were hit in Kiev region:
▫️
a uncrewed surface vehicle
manufacturing and storing workshop
in the settlement of Khotov;
▫️
an oil refinery
delivering POLs to the AFU in the settlement of Borispol.
📍
The following targets were hit in Odessa and Odessa region:
▫️
an electric power plant and three electric substations,
which operated the port infrastructure, as well as a UAV assembly workshop;
💥
16 depots
with military weaponry and hardware and
six POL tanks
supplied to the Armed Forces of Ukraine by Western countries in the port of Odessa;
💥
two depots with military equipment intended for supplying the Armed Forces of Ukraine in the port of Chernomorsk;
💥
a border
checkpoint
and
a ferry crossing
in Orlovka.
🔹
Russian Defence Ministry
